properties.description: The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014), directed by Wes Anderson and featuring Ralph Fiennes, F. Murray Abraham, and Mathieu Amalric, is a comedy-drama adventure set across multiple eras of a once-grand European hotel. Framed as a nested tale, it follows a legendary concierge and his young lobby boy through a caper involving a stolen painting, an inheritance dispute, and a murder, all against the rise of war and social change. The film pairs Anderson's signature visual precision—pastel palettes, miniature-like sets, and exacting symmetry—with a bittersweet meditation on nostalgia, loyalty, and the decay of an era.

short_descriptions.value: A charismatic concierge and his loyal lobby boy become unlikely partners in a whimsical caper that crosses love, theft, and the upheaval of prewar Europe.
Ein charismatischer Concierge und sein treuer Page werden zu ungleichen Komplizen in einem skurrilen Abenteuer über Liebe, Diebstahl und das aufbrechende Europa vor dem Krieg.
Un carismático concierge y su leal botones se convierten en improbables socios en una comedia de enredos que mezcla amor, robo y el convulso periodo prebélico europeo.
Un concierge charismatique et son fidèle groom deviennent partenaires improbables dans une comédie d'aventures mêlant amour, vol et les remous de l'Europe d'avant-guerre.
